original_test_intent: Measure receive eye opening on every approved Grace CPU PCIe root port with an attached endpoint and verify per-lane margin meets the platform limit without degrading the link.
original_method: Pin NVQual EOM artifact/config; map Grace socket/root port/lane to endpoint serial/BDF/slot; baseline speed/width/AER/traffic; approve EOM coordinates/units/thresholds and link effects; isolate I/O; run bounded measurements; retain every lane result and restore link/services/health.
manual_activity: Signal-integrity/vendor owner supplies lane mapping and numeric EOM acceptance; operator drains affected endpoint I/O and owns link recovery.
required_inputs: EOM definition, units, sample settings and per-lane threshold
safety_requirements: Do not probe unmapped live ports
No guessed subcommand or no-reboot assumption
Preserve zero/missing lanes and raw margin output
agent_execution_scope: Validate artifact, topology, oracle and approval
Run one bounded allowlisted EOM capture

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The guessed command has no sourced parameters, lane map or margin oracle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned vendor EOM module/config for explicit Grace root ports and mapped endpoints.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Grace RX root-port eye measurement remains the required property; absent settings are not fabricated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a root-port/endpoint/lane matrix with raw EOM values, units, limits and link state before/after.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds electrical oracle, topology and link safety.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readable output and firmware correctness cannot prove eye margin.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor EOM values may be implementation-specific and measurement can perturb a live link.

project_override_considerations: Signal-integrity authority defines whether all lanes, worst lane or aggregate margin determines acceptance.
expected_evidence: Recovery/final link health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure specifies Grace RX eye measurement; Criteria test only text and firmware, with no EOM acceptance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Vendor/topology/oracle inputs are provisionable; execution awaits controlled approval.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row305 Wistron-NV GPU-00298-V003: approve exact Grace RX EOM module/config, root-port/endpoint/lane map, EOM fields/units/sample settings and numeric per-lane rule, link effects/isolation/recovery, and map or replace unrelated readability/FW Criteria.

review_improvement: Makes the intended electrical margin measurable per physical Grace lane and prevents a generic log screen from replacing it.
independent_technical_reasoning: Eye opening is a lane-level receiver property, so endpoint presence and firmware strings are not a proxy. Without port/lane topology and vendor-specific units, even a numeric margin cannot be compared or attributed safely.
